days.caption: deadline
entries: Hari ini capek banget. Meeting dari pagi sampai sore, terus deadline-nya dimajuin ke Rabu. I didn't even have lunch properly.
Deck-nya akhirnya ke-submit jam 9 malam. Lega sih, tapi rasanya kosong aja.
Pulang naik MRT, dengerin podcast. Honestly I just want to sleep.

days.caption: makan malam sama Ibu
entries: Makan malam sama Ibu di Kemang. Dia cerita soal kebun di rumah, and for the first time this week I wasn't thinking about work.

days.caption: coffee before the run
entries: Lari pagi 5K di GBK, terus ngopi. It was the first quiet morning in weeks.
Sore beresin kamar sambil dengerin lagu lama.
